title: Location Data Linkability
description: Geofencing Engine (P2) may correlate location pings over time to track user movements, enabling linkage to specific individuals.
assumptions: P2 retains historical location data with user identifiers.
uncertainty_note: Node ID L.1.1 assumed based on common LINDDUN Pro structure; exact node may vary.

title: User Re-identification Risk
description: Location data forwarded to P2 may contain or enable derivation of unique identifiers (e.g., device IDs), allowing re-identification of users.
assumptions: P2 processes data with persistent identifiers.
uncertainty_note: Node ID I.1.1 inferred; exact mapping to LINDDUN Pro tree uncertain.

title: Unauthorized Data Interception
description: Location pings transmitted from P1 to P2 may be intercepted if communication channels lack encryption.
assumptions: Data in transit is not encrypted or uses weak security.
uncertainty_note: Node ID D.1.1 assumed; exact threat-tree node may differ.

title: Lack of User Transparency
description: Users may be unaware that their location data is forwarded to the Geofencing Engine (P2) for processing.
assumptions: App privacy policy does not explicitly disclose this data flow.
uncertainty_note: Node ID U.1.1 inferred; LINDDUN Pro tree structure not fully verified.

title: Regulatory Non-Compliance
description: Processing location data in P2 may violate GDPR/CCPA if consent mechanisms or data minimization principles are not followed.
assumptions: P2 processes data without explicit user consent or beyond stated purposes.
uncertainty_note: Node ID Nc.1.1 assumed; exact regulatory mapping uncertain.
